absence_claim_rule: F(k)=false may be opened only when all A0-A5 absence-identifiability gates pass prospectively for that candidate/key. Otherwise the key remains unresolved/unavailable and cannot count as a biological negative.

absence_identifiability_gates.A0_key_observable: the exact operational event key k and observation window are materializable without using outcome values to choose them
absence_identifiability_gates.A1_function_channel_directness: Y measures the required biological function or a prespecified complete functional proxy, not provider occurrence or generic suitability
absence_identifiability_gates.A2_coverage_completeness: the Y observation window covers the complete prespecified functional opportunity or a validated sampling design that supports absence inference
absence_identifiability_gates.A3_detection_adequacy: a prespecified sensitivity/detection model or validation result bounds false absence for the relevant function state
absence_identifiability_gates.A4_missingness_separation: missing/retrieval failure/device failure/occlusion/unsampled intervals are separable from observed negative states
absence_identifiability_gates.A5_negative_decision_rule: a prospective deterministic decision rule maps only adequate negative observations to F(k)=false; zeros without adequacy remain unresolved

CREMV3-007.allowed_negative_evidence: only a validated camera/observation design whose coverage and sensitivity are sufficient to rule out the required function over the frozen opportunity

BELV3-012.allowed_negative_evidence: only directly observed and adequately sampled no-budbreak/no-usable-resource state for the frozen host-time key
BELV3-012.forbidden_negative_shortcut: missing budbreak record or no observation row
